guards._note: daily: flatten at -2.0% of the day anchor (max of balance/equity at the first pass of the server day) = 1% headroom under the firm's 3% for exit slippage. session._note: Evening no-increase gate OFF, matching the FTMO deployment of this same book. It was measured on the 4-sleeve book, not this 2-sleeve one, and BTC trades 24/7 so a nightly block is a materially different constraint for the crypto sleeve. Set disabled=false to restore.

firm_limits._note: FIRM rules, read from the user's table 2026-11-27: Step1 10% / Step2 5% / Funded none; daily drawdown 3% all stages; max loss 8% STATIC (funded: static until first payout); min PROFITABLE days 3 / 3 / 4 per payout; consistency 40% funded only; floating loss limit 1% of all open trades FUNDED ONLY; max daily profit $3,000 funded only; payout cap $2,000; split 80%.

_vol_note: 9% book vol at 1x cushion (sim best for pass rate x time). Size = 9% x cushion multiplier (0..2).
_reset_tz_note: Server clock verified 2026-11-27 = UTC+2 with D1 bars at 00:00 and H1 bars 01-23, i.e. NY+7 (17:00 New York day). NY+7 follows US DST, so the daily anchor stays on the server's day all year.

cushion_sizing._note: size x (equity - 92,000) / 8,000, clipped [0, 2]: 1x at start, 2x at +8%, -> 0 near the floor. Resets per phase only if initial_balance re-anchors (new account).

_stop_loss_note: Broker-side stop per symbol capping its loss at 3% of equity: if the VPS dies, the two sleeves can lose at most ~6%, inside the 8% static wall. It does NOT protect the 3% daily limit; the 2-minute guard does.
_min_days_note: GFT requires 3 PROFITABLE days per step. The report counts trading days; a slow book reaching +10% in under 3 profitable days is not realistic, but check before requesting promotion.
_port_note: Bridge 18819 = prefix ~/.mt5h, display :106 (xvfb8), unit mt5-terminal-goat. ExecStop pkills 'rpyc.*18819': never run an inline command containing that text.
